description: Structured eval definitions for the WAF Rule Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across WAF rule topologies (CloudFront ACL with managed rules + custom allow at priority 0, regional ALB ACL with rate-based and geo-match, WCU budget overage failure, logging Firehose naming violation, CloudFront scope in wrong region). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: CloudFront Web ACL with managed rules and specific-allow-before-broad-block
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — CloudFront scope us-east-1, managed rule groups (CommonRuleSet/SQLi/IPReputation), custom allow at priority 0 before geo block at priority 40, WCU budget cited, logging via Firehose aws-waf-logs-*
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront Web ACL named production-cloudfront-acl protecting distribution E1234567890 in account 123456789012. Add AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, and AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList managed rule groups. Add a custom allow rule for partner CIDRs (IP set partner-cidrs with 203.0.113.0/24 and 198.51.100.10/32) at priority 0. Add a custom block for high-risk geos RU and KP at priority 40. Enable logging to Firehose aws-waf-logs-production (S3 bucket waf-logs-bucket, redact Authorization header). Default action ALLOW. Tags: Environment=production, Protected=cloudfront.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WAF_RULE_SET: production-cloudfront-acl (CLOUDFRONT, us-east-1) — 926/1500 WCU
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Scope: CLOUDFRONT (us-east-1)
  [✓] Default action: ALLOW
  [✓] Custom rule: allow-partner-ip — priority 0 — action ALLOW — IPSetMatch(partner-cidrs) — 1 WCU
  [✓] Managed rule group: AWS/AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet — priority 10 — 700 WCU
  [✓] Managed rule group: AWS/AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet — priority 20 — 200 WCU
  [✓] Managed rule group: AWS/AWSManagedRulesAmazonIpReputationList — priority 30 — 20 WCU
  [✓] Custom rule: block-high-risk-geo — priority 40 — action BLOCK — GeoMatch(RU, KP) — 3 WCU
  [✓] WCU budget: 926 / 1500 (574 WCU headroom)
  [✓] Priority order: allow-partner-ip (0) before block-high-risk-geo (40) — VERIFIED
  [✓] Logging: Firehose aws-waf-logs-production → S3 waf-logs-bucket (redacted: Authorization)
  [✓] CloudFront association: arn:aws:cloudfront::123456789012:distribution/E1234567890
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws wafv2 get-web-acl --scope CLOUDFRONT --id <acl-id> --region us-east-1
  aws wafv2 get-logging-configuration --web-acl-arn <arn> --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Regional ALB Web ACL with rate-based rule and geo-match block
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — Regional scope us-west-2, rate-based rule 100/5min per IP on /login, geo-match block RU/KP
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Regional Web ACL named api-protection-acl protecting ALB arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/api-alb/1234567890 in us-west-2. Add a rate-based rule blocking IPs exceeding 100 requests per 5 minutes on /login (priority 100, action BLOCK). Add a geo-match block for countries RU and KP at priority 40. Default action ALLOW. Tags: Environment=production, Service=api.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WAF_RULE_SET: api-protection-acl (REGIONAL, us-west-2) — 4/1500 WCU
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Scope: REGIONAL (us-west-2)
  [✓] Default action: ALLOW
  [✓] Custom rule: block-high-risk-geo — priority 40 — action BLOCK — GeoMatch(RU, KP) — 3 WCU
  [✓] Custom rule: rate-limit-login — priority 100 — action BLOCK — RateBased(100/5min, IP) on /login
  [✓] WCU budget: 4 / 1500 (1496 WCU headroom)
  [✓] Priority order: geo-block (40) before rate-based (100) — VERIFIED
  [✓] ALB association: arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-west-2:123456789012:loadbalancer/app/api-alb/1234567890

eval_cases.name: Web ACL exceeding 1500 WCU budget (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — too many managed rule groups + custom regex rules; total WCU exceeds 1500
eval_cases.prompt: Create a Web ACL with AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesLinuxRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesWindowsRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesUnixRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesPHPRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesWordPressRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesBotControlRuleSet, AWSManagedRulesATPRuleSet, and 20 custom regex pattern set match rules. Account 123456789012, region us-east-1, scope CLOUDFRONT.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WAF_RULE_SET: (CLOUDFRONT, us-east-1) — WCU OVER BUDGET
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] WCU budget: ~2040 / 1500 (exceeds limit by ~540 WCU)
  → Offload to referenced rule groups or reduce managed rule set count

eval_cases.name: WAF logging to Firehose without aws-waf-logs- prefix (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — Firehose stream waf-traffic-stream does not start with aws-waf-logs-
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront Web ACL named edge-protection in us-east-1. Enable logging to Firehose stream waf-traffic-stream delivering to S3 bucket waf-logs-bucket. Add AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet. Default action ALLOW. Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WAF_RULE_SET: edge-protection (CLOUDFRONT, us-east-1)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Logging: Firehose stream 'waf-traffic-stream' does not start with required prefix 'aws-waf-logs-'

eval_cases.name: CloudFront-scoped Web ACL in us-west-2 (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — CloudFront scope requires us-east-1; operator specified us-west-2
eval_cases.prompt: Create a CloudFront Web ACL named cdn-protection in us-west-2 protecting distribution E9876543210. Add AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet and AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet. Default action BLOCK. Account 123456789012.
eval_cases.expected_output:
WAF_RULE_SET: cdn-protection (CLOUDFRONT, us-west-2)
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Scope/region: CLOUDFRONT scope requires us-east-1; operator specified us-west-2 — recreate in us-east-1
